item.title: Mercedes spent millions on nurturing Antonelli after Ferrari said no
item.description: Ferrari fans can only imagine what might have been had local boy Kimi Antonelli signed for their team rather than Mercedes as a young go-karter.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Ferrari fans can only imagine what might have been had local boy Kimi Antonelli signed for their team rather than Mercedes as a young go-karter. Formula One's oldest and most successful team had the chance to secure the talent now [USN:L6N46B095 TEXT:"set to become Italy's first champion in 73 years"], and Formula One's youngest ever, but let it slip through their fingers. Mercedes seized the opportunity instead in 2018, when Antonelli was 11. "For Ferrari, Kimi was still too young whereas Mercedes could offer better guarantees regarding his future prospects," Antonelli's former manager Giovanni Minardi told the Gazzetta dello Sport newspaper earlier this year. Former Ferrari president Luca di Montezemolo, who was no longer involved with the team at that point, saw a silver lining. "I am a Ferrari man but I'm delighted to see what Antonelli is doing," he told Spanish newspaper AS last month. "What I do regret is that Ferrari had the chance to sign him. They didn't. "A great opportunity vanished, but almost better for Antonelli. Such a young Italian driving a Ferrari... It would have been terrible pressure." Mercedes team boss and co-owner Toto Wolff credited Gwen Lagrue, who is [USN:L6N43T0TM TEXT:"joining Red Bull next year"] to run their young driver programme, for bringing Antonelli, now 20, on board. He said also that people did not appreciate the amount of work that has gone into nurturing the team's successor to seven-time world champion Lewis Hamilton. "I read an interview with Piero Ferrari last week where he said, 'What a talent. He reminds me of Niki Lauda'. And I'm thinking, 'People don't get that this is the work of nine years'," the Austrian told reporters after Antonelli won last Sunday's US Grand Prix in Austin, his ninth win of the season. "The development of nine years, the hardship of nine years, the integration of the team, the working with the engineers, the 10 or more millions spent in the development of his career, of his ability, of his character together with his parents. "It's just not that it landed like this." Wolff recalled how others said Antonelli, after nine rounds without points last year, should not have been given the Mercedes seat. He spoke of those at other teams who suggested the youngster should not even be in Formula One. "All of that now is extremely satisfying, to see what he's able to deliver and how he's working with the team, with (race engineer Peter) Bono (Bonnington) and yielding the results. But it wasn't an easy road."

item.title: Hacking attempts against US Federal Election Commission system triggered outage, email shows
item.description: The US Federal Election Commission's website has been targeted by a hacker or hackers, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections, according to an email seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Dawn Kopecki
item.content:encoded: The US Federal Election Commission's website has been targeted by a hacker or hackers, disrupting the agency's electronic filings system a week before the November 3 elections, according to an email seen by Reuters. In a statement, the FEC said that, "at this time, the FEC’s electronic filing system is currently offline and our IT staff are actively working to restore service." The FEC, which tracks the spending of candidates and political committees, said that users could still search the website for past reports. It declined further comment on the outage. The hacking attempts come a week before the [TOPIC:"reuters:/world/us/elections/" TEXT:"midterm elections"], which will determine whether President Donald Trump's Republicans maintain their majorities in Congress for the next two years. The FEC does not play a role in administering US elections and the outage should have no effect on voters' ability to cast ballots. The outage prevents organizations from filing the FEC's 24-hour and 48-hour spending reports, which show how much political groups and others are spending on specific races. "I've never seen this in 26 years," said Steven Mele, a partner at political finance compliance firm MBA Consulting Group. "The result is there will be less disclosure on the elections" until it's fixed. A status message posted by the FEC noted that its filing system had been down since around 10 p.m. ET on Monday (0200 GMT Tuesday). The Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency and the FBI did not immediately return messages seeking comment.

item.title: トランプ氏、ＡＩの呼称は「不正確」 近く公式禁止する考え表明
item.description: [ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２７日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は、文書などで「人工知能（ＡＩ）」という用語の使用を禁止する考えを示した。自身が好む「超知能（スーパーインテリジェンス、ＳＩ）」を米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）が使わないのはなぜかと疑問を呈した。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で、「ＷＳＪはいつになったら、非常に悪く不正確な『ＡＩ』の呼称を、事実上誰もが使用している、あるいは間もなく使用するようになる『ＳＩ』と呼ぶようになるのか」と述べた。

その上で「われわれは近く、その不正確さを理由に、『ＡＩ』という用語を全ての関連文書やその他あらゆる場面において公式に禁止する」と述べた。

item.title: ＥＵ・アジアの市場アクセス拡大呼びかけ、独首相 アジア歴訪スタート
item.description:
Andreas Rinke
[シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Andreas Rinke

[シンガポール ２７日 ロイター] - ドイツのメルツ首相は２７日、アジア歴訪の最初の訪問国となったシンガポールのシンクタンクで講演し、欧州とアジアとの間で市場アクセスを拡大し、貿易や技術、安全保障面で協力関係を強めることを呼びかけた。

メルツ氏は、世界秩序の崩壊により共通の利益が脅かされているとして「われわれは地政学上の新たな時代の入り口にいる」と主張。「自由や主権、安全、繁栄が危機にさらされている」として、緊密な協力の必要性を訴えた。具体的には、日本や英国、カナダ、シンガポールなど１２カ国が加盟する包括的・先進的環太平洋経済連携協定（ＣＰＴＰＰ）の加盟国と欧州連合（ＥＵ）の２つの大きな枠組みの連携を提唱した。これらを合わせると「世界貿易の３分の１以上を占める」と指摘。欧州とアジアの関係強化は「長期的かつ戦略的」なものだとし、「新時代に対する最も重要な対応の一つ」だと言及した。

メルツ氏は、中国との完全な経済面でのデカップリング（切り離し）に関しては「誤り」であり、「安全も繁栄ももたらさない」との見解を示した。切り離しではなく、サプライチェーン（供給網）や技術、資源などで「不健全で一方的な依存」を減らす必要があると主張。同時に、貿易面での競争が「過剰生産能力や市場アクセスへの制限で歪められている場合には、是正が必要だ」と述べた。

メルツ氏は今回のアジア歴訪で、日本や韓国なども訪問する予定だ。

item.title: French minister: talks progressing over Germany buying 50% stake in KNDS from German owner families
item.description: French defence minister Catherine Vautrin said on Tuesday that talks were moving ahead regarding plans by the German government to buy a 50% stake in Franco-German tank maker KNDS from its German owner families.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: French defence minister Catherine Vautrin said on Tuesday that talks were moving ahead regarding plans by the German government to buy a 50% stake in [USN:L8N4601KT TEXT:"Franco-German tank maker KNDS"] from its German owner families. "I believe that talks are progressing with a view towards a purchase by the German government," Vautrin told a parliamentary hearing. KNDS CEO Jean-Paul Alary told Reuters on October 19 that he would [USN:L8N4650ZZ TEXT:"prefer an initial public offering"]as soon as market conditions allow, adding he welcomed the German government taking a stake in the company.

item.title: Food and household brands warn of more price hikes as Iran war costs bite
item.description: The world's top consumer goods and food companies, from Coca-Cola and Procter & Gamble to Nestle and Reckitt, have warned of further price hikes next year to cover rising costs even as shoppers remain reluctant to splurge on groceries.
item.dc:creator: Alexander Marrow, Anuja Mistry
item.content:encoded: The world's top consumer goods and food companies, from Coca-Cola and Procter & Gamble to Nestle and Reckitt, have warned of further price hikes next year to cover rising costs even as shoppers remain reluctant to splurge on groceries. Higher energy, raw material and freight costs as a result of the US war on Iran mean that the companies making everything from laundry detergent to soda and snacks face a balancing act to protect profit margins. Even higher prices on everyday items will fuel concerns that inflation will persist into next year. High gas and grocery bills are a big factor in next week's US midterm elections . Soaring costs related to the war are the latest headache for consumer goods, food and drink companies, which have struggled with lacklustre sales since the pandemic, as shoppers have baulked at increasingly expensive name-brand packaged food. Last year, they had to contend with tariffs on imported goods imposed by US President Donald Trump. "Pricing is the last lever these companies have left, and they’re pulling it into a consumer who’s already tapped out on paying more," said David Wagner, head of equity and portfolio manager at PepsiCo investor Aptus Capital Advisors. On Tuesday, Coca-Cola (KO.N) CEO Henrique Braun said pressure on consumers could extend into 2027. "We are seeing elevated cost pressures ... driven by increased logistics and transportation costs," he said as the company [USN:L3N46D109 TEXT:"raised its annual profit forecast"]. HOW HIGH CAN PRICES GO? The challenge is working out how high prices can rise before shoppers walk away. The chair of Lindt & Sprüngli (LISN.S) said the Swiss chocolate maker is struggling because it [USN:L2N46A04K TEXT:"misjudged"] how consumers would respond to price increases. He spoke days after the company [USN:L6N4650EX TEXT:"ousted its CEO"] over concerns about its performance. Companies are running out of ways to absorb costs. Consumers in Europe and North America are particularly squeezed, said Reckitt (RKT.L) CEO Kris Licht. He said companies must decide how much of the cost increase to pass on through pricing and how much to offset with more promotional spending. "We will probably have to price more at this level of commodity costs and input costs," Licht said after the Durex maker trimmed its annual revenue forecast, sending its shares down around 5% on Tuesday. Procter & Gamble (PG.N) CFO Andre Schulten expressed a similar view after the Tide detergent maker last week hiked its expected [USN:L4N46811U TEXT:"hit to profit"] from rising raw material, energy and freight costs to $1.4 billion from $1 billion. "At this level of commodity pressure ... the industry generally is pricing up because there is no way to recover this level of commodity pressure without pricing," Schulten said. Procter & Gamble's pricing and sales held steady in the last quarter, but higher costs really hurt margins, said Brian Mulberry, chief market strategist at Zacks Investment Management. "Consumers are still spending if they see the value ... but we likely are near the upper limit of what consumers are willing to pay for snacks," Mulberry said. PepsiCo (PEP.O) has swung between price rises and cuts this year in an effort to boost sluggish sales and it [USN:L6N45U0N9 TEXT:"suffered a margin hit"] last quarter. Raising prices risks losing customers. Nestle (NESN.S) CFO Anna Manz said last week that volumes can dip in the short term when the company raises prices, as consumers adjust. "Looking forward, there's now again some upward pressure on input costs," Manz said as Nestle posted faster quarterly volume growth than pricing growth [USN:L6N4680BP TEXT:"for the first time"] since 2024. "We'll take pricing to the extent we can without damaging medium-term consumer penetration," she said.

item.title: FDA warns Amgen over cancer drug promotional video
item.description: The US FDA on Tuesday warned Amgen that a promotional video for its colorectal cancer drug was misleading because it highlighted the benefits while failing to adequately disclose serious safety risks and patient limitations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US FDA on Tuesday warned Amgen (AMGN.O) that a promotional video for its colorectal cancer drug was misleading because it highlighted the benefits while failing to adequately disclose serious safety risks and patient limitations. Here are some details: In a warning letter dated August 12, the FDA said the video promoted the drug Vectibix as an option for adults with a type of advanced colorectal cancer and noted that infusions can take 60 minutes or less and do not require premedication The regulator said that the video contained no information on risk, despite Vectibix carrying a boxed warning for severe skin reactions The drug can also cause potentially fatal infusion reactions, lung disease, kidney failure and other serious side effects, the FDA said The regulator said the video failed to disclose which type of patients can use Vectibix, including limits tied to tumor testing "By failing to adequately communicate the full indication for Vectibix and limitations of use associated with Vectibix, the video creates a misleading impression about the drug's FDA-approved indication and use," the FDA said The regulator told Amgen to stop using misleading promotional material, submit a written response within 15 working days and propose corrective communications for the video's audience It said failure to address the issues could lead to legal action, including product seizure or an injunction

item.title: US agency approves Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion acquisition of Globalstar
item.description: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it has approved Amazon Leo’s $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar as the retail giant's satellite arm aims to build a satellite-based communications network to take on Elon Musk's SpaceX Starlink unit .
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The Federal Communications Commission said Tuesday it has approved Amazon (AMZN.O) Leo’s $11.5 billion deal to acquire Globalstar (GSAT.O) as the retail giant's satellite arm aims to build a satellite-based communications network to take on Elon Musk's SpaceX Starlink unit (SPCX.O) . Amazon Leo has launched more than 300 satellites since April 2025 and aims to deploy about 3,200 satellites in Earth's low orbit by 2029. Through the deal, Amazon adds Globalstar's two dozen satellites to its existing network of more than 200 and its mobile-satellite spectrum. Amazon, which has committed to investing more than $10 billion in Leo, is preparing to roll out its commercial satellite services by the end of 2026, the FCC said. The FCC said the companies’ assets will boost Amazon Leo’s entry into the direct-to-device market and allow the satellite-operator to offer fixed and mobile services. "The FCC has empowered Amazon Leo to deliver fast, next-gen satellite broadband services, increase competition, and help communities stay connected all across the country," FCC Chair Brendan Carr said. Direct-to-device satellite technology allows smartphones and other devices to connect directly to satellites. Tech companies are pouring billions of dollars into capturing the lucrative market for satellite-based connectivity as they race to complete with Starlink's network of more than 11,000 satellites. The FCC will vote Thursday to advance a new auction of wireless spectrum to boost "direct-to-device" services. Globalstar currently powers satellite-based safety features such as Emergency SOS and Find My for Apple's (AAPL.O) iPhone and Apple Watch users. Amazon said earlier that it has signed an agreement with Apple to continue providing those services. Apple invested about $1.5 billion in Globalstar in 2024 to fund the expansion of its iPhone communication services, in a deal that also gave the tech giant a 20% equity in Globalstar. Apple accounted for about 63% of Globalstar revenue last year and Amazon plans to acquire Apple's stake, the FCC said. Globalstar said late last year that a new, Apple-backed network under development would expand its footprint to 54 satellites, including a small number of backups, from the two dozen currently.

item.title: Mexico's electoral body INE names interim chief after resignation over corruption
item.description: Mexico's National Electoral Institute named Blanca Cruz as its interim president on Tuesday, according to several local media reports, following the resignation of Guadalupe Taddei amid allegations of irregularities and corruption at the electoral authority.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Mexico's National Electoral Institute named Blanca Cruz as its interim president on Tuesday, according to several local media reports, following the resignation of Guadalupe Taddei amid allegations of irregularities and corruption at the electoral authority. Cruz, an electoral adviser who joined the INE's General Council in April, will lead the autonomous body until Taddei's permanent successor is named by lawmakers. Taddei [USN:L2N46C0L2 TEXT:"resigned"] on Monday, in the most high-profile departure tied to alleged corruption in President Claudia Sheinbaum's two-year-old presidency. Sheinbaum said she supported Taddei's decision. "It is a good time for whoever takes office to exercise transparency and ensure that no department within the National Electoral Institute favors any particular side, and that the Institute fulfills its duties," Sheinbaum said at her daily press conference on Tuesday. The abrupt leadership change comes as the INE prepares to oversee Mexico's 2027 midterm elections, and could risk damaging the electoral institute's credibility.

item.title: ブラジル大統領選敗北のボルソナロ氏、米へ出国か 旅券提出命令応じず＝関係筋
item.description:
Ricardo Brito Gram Slattery
[サンパウロ ２７日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Ricardo Brito　Gram Slattery

[サンパウロ ２７日 ロイター] - ブラジル大統領選で現職のルラ大統領に敗れたフラビオ・ボルソナロ上院議員が、連邦最高裁判所のパスポート提出命令に従わずに米国に向けて出国したことが関係筋２人の話で分かった。

この件に関して、在ブラジル米国大使館からコメントは得られていない。ボルソナロ氏の弁護士はコメントを控えている。ブラジル連邦警察の高官は、ボルソナロ氏が通常の出入国審査手続きを経て国外に出た記録は確認されていないとしている。

フラビオ氏は大統領選の第１回投票では首位に立っていたが、２５日に行われた決選投票でルラ氏に敗北。フラビオ氏は２６日、収監されている父親のジャイル・ボルソナロ前大統領と面会した後、連邦警察からパスポートの提出を求められたと明らかにしていた。

関係筋によると、フラビオ氏は資金洗浄（マネーロンダリング）捜査の一環として２６日に２４時間以内のパスポート提出を命じられていた。別の関係筋２人によると、この期限が過ぎたことを受け、同氏のパスポートは失効扱いになっているという。

フラビオ氏の父親のジャイル氏は２０２２年の大統領選でルラ氏への敗北を認めることを拒否した後、米国に渡航。ジャイル氏はその後ブラジルに帰国したが、クーデターを企てた罪で禁錮２７年の判決を受けた。

米国在住のフラビオ氏の弟、エドゥアルド・ボルソナロ氏は大統領選の決選投票前、ポッドキャスターのスティーブン・クラウダー氏に対し「兄が勝てなければ、国外へ出るべきだと考えている」と述べ、フラビオ氏が選挙に敗れた場合には国外移住が必要になるとの認識を示していた。

item.title: Connor Hellebuyck to make Devils' debut vs. Stars
item.description: Connor Hellebuyck will make his debut with the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday when he starts against the Dallas Stars, head coach Sheldon Keefe announced.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Connor Hellebuyck will make his debut with the New Jersey Devils on Tuesday when he starts against the Dallas Stars, head coach Sheldon Keefe announced. The Devils acquired the star goaltender from the Winnipeg Jets last Friday, the same day his suspension for failing to report to training camp ended. Hellebuyck, 33, is a three-time Vezina Trophy winner as the NHL's top goalie and 2025 Hart Trophy recipient as the league MVP. He has not played in an NHL game since April 13. Hellebuyck was the star of the U.S. Olympic team that won the gold medal at the 2026 Winter Games in Milan Cortina. He made 41 saves as the U.S. beat Canada 2-1 in overtime in the final. Hellebuyck had a down season by his standards in 2025-26, finishing 23-23-11 with a 2.86 goals-against average and a career-worst .895 save percentage. Winnipeg failed to make the playoffs, going 35-35-12. In 625 career NHL games, Hellebuyck has a 345-208-55 record with 45 shutouts, a 2.58 GAA and a .916 save percentage. --Field Level Media

item.title: Bengals place TE Erick All Jr. (knee) on IR
item.description: The Cincinnati Bengals placed Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and signed fellow tight end Cam Grandy off the Minnesota Vikings' practice squad on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The Cincinnati Bengals placed Erick All Jr. on injured reserve and signed fellow tight end Cam Grandy off the Minnesota Vikings' practice squad on Tuesday. All, 26, sustained a knee injury during Sunday's 35-13 win at Baltimore. NFL Network reported the injury is believed to be a torn ACL. He missed the last seven games of his 2024 rookie season and the entire 2025 campaign with the same injury. All caught eight passes for 56 yards in six games (one start) this season. He has 28 catches for 214 yards and no touchdowns in 15 games (seven starts) since Cincinnati drafted him in the fourth round in 2024. Grandy, 25, rejoins the Bengals, who signed him as an undrafted free agent in 2024 and waived him following training camp this summer. He played in 13 games (seven starts) for Cincinnati from 2024-25, catching seven passes for 35 yards. Cincinnati also signed Caden Prieskorn to the practice squad and placed fellow tight end Josh Kattus on the practice squad injured list. --Field Level Media

item.title: Shopee eleva capacidade em 60% em um ano e aguarda Anvisa para venda de medicamentos
item.description: A Shopee disse nesta terça-feira que abriu mais quatro centros de distribuição no Brasil, consolidando um movimento de expansão logística que aumentou sua capacidade de processamento de pedidos em 60% no último ano.
item.dc:creator: Andre Romani
item.content:encoded: A Shopee disse nesta terça-feira que abriu mais quatro centros de distribuição no Brasil, consolidando um movimento de expansão logística que aumentou sua capacidade de processamento de pedidos em 60% no último ano. A plataforma de comércio eletrônico, da empresa de Cingapura Sea (SE.N) , inaugurou centros de distribuição em Recife, Rio de Janeiro, Vitória e Blumenau (SC), enquanto triplicou a área operacional de seu centro em Piracicaba (SP). As inaugurações levam o total de centros de distribuição da Shopee no Brasil a 30, contra 16 há um ano. São 25 unidades no modelo de passagem "cross-docking", incluindo as quatro novas e o complexo em Piracicaba, e cinco centros "fulfillment", em que a companhia também estoca produtos de vendedores. A Shopee entrou no Brasil em 2020 e, atualmente, é uma das principais empresas de comércio eletrônico no Brasil, disputando o mercado principalmente com Amazon (AMZN.O) e Mercado Livre (MELI.O) . A companhia afirma ter mais de 3 milhões de vendedores locais em sua plataforma. A companhia disse que as novas quatro unidades, mais a expansão em Piracicaba, adicionaram capacidade de processamento de 2,4 milhões de pedidos por dia. A empresa não diz qual é sua capacidade total em produtos no Brasil. Mas, para base de comparação, afirma que vendeu mais de 20 milhões de itens no último 11 de novembro, o 11/11, principal data promocional da companhia no país, acima inclusive da Black Friday. Para este ano, a Shopee disse que prepara R$25 milhões em cupons de desconto no 11/11, contra R$20 milhões no ano passado, e R$23 milhões para a sexta-feira de Black Friday, versus R$16 milhões em 2025. "Estamos muito focados em crescer nossa capacidade agora para atender esse aumento expressivo de demanda do final do ano", disse o diretor de logística e estratégia da Shopee, Tiago Freddi, durante evento da empresa em seu centro de distribuição em Franco da Rocha (SP). REGULAÇÃO SOBRE MEDICAMENTOS A Shopee vai esperar a conclusão de regulamentação pela Anvisa antes de potencialmente liberar farmácias para venderem medicamentos em sua plataforma, disse o diretor de desenvolvimento de negócios e operações de fulfillment, Felipe Lima. "A gente tem acompanhado muito a regulamentação, inclusive, em discussões com a Anvisa, e nós entendemos que a gente precisa ainda ter mais clareza quanto a essa legislação antes de fazer algum movimento," disse. O Mercado Livre [USN:L1N45Z11G TEXT:"iniciou no último mês"] a venda de medicamentos no país, tanto por sua farmácia própria quanto por farmácias terceiras. Uma lei aprovada pelo Congresso e sancionada neste ano autorizou a venda de medicamentos em marketplaces. A Anvisa, porém, ainda prepara uma regulamentação própria sobre o assunto. No caso da Shopee, que não tem uma operação própria de varejo -- o chamado 1P --, a eventual venda de remédios seria apenas por meio de farmácias terceiras, disse Felipe Piringer, diretor de marketing. Atualmente, mais de 40 redes de farmácias já vendem outros produtos, como cosméticos, na Shopee. Lima disse que o entendimento da Shopee é de que os medicamentos precisarão ser direcionados diretamente da farmácia ao consumidor, o que a empresa poderia atender através de sua [USN:L6N44A0UC TEXT:"operação Turbo"], lançada em agosto em São Paulo e que promete entregas em até 4 horas.

item.title: FIFA visitará en noviembre y diciembre las posibles ciudades sede del Mundial de 2030
item.description: La FIFA dijo el martes que llevará a cabo una serie de visitas a las ciudades candidatas de España, Portugal y Marruecos en noviembre y diciembre, como parte del proceso de selección de sedes para el Mundial 2030.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: La FIFA dijo el martes que llevará a cabo una serie de visitas a las ciudades candidatas de España, Portugal y Marruecos en noviembre y diciembre, como parte del proceso de selección de sedes para el Mundial 2030. Una delegación de la FIFA visitará las ciudades candidatas y los estadios de los tres países anfitriones para evaluar su idoneidad para acoger los partidos. La FIFA aún no ha confirmado qué sedes se incluirán, ni ha anunciado dónde se celebrará la final del Mundial, por lo que España y Marruecos compiten por acoger el partido más importante del torneo. Se han programado visitas a Agadir, Casablanca, Fez, Marrakech, Rabat y Tánger, en Marruecos; Lisboa y Oporto, en Portugal; y Barcelona, Bilbao, Las Palmas, Madrid, San Sebastián, Sevilla y Zaragoza, en España. La FIFA ha indicado que también podría realizar visitas a otras sedes durante el proceso de selección. Añadió que la asignación de los partidos y el tipo de encuentros que se disputarán en cada sede se determinarán una vez que se haya confirmado la lista definitiva de ciudades anfitrionas y avance la elaboración del calendario del torneo. Los tres primeros partidos del Mundial 2030 se disputarán en Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay, en homenaje al centenario de la competición, que se celebró por primera vez en 1930 en Uruguay.

item.title: Jio Platforms shares trade at 22% premium in grey market ahead of IPO debut
item.description: Jio Platforms' $3.1 billion IPO attracted over $78 billion in bids, while its grey market premium held near 22% ahead of its October 28 debut ...
item.dc:creator: Bloomberg
item.content:encoded: For investors lucky enough to land shares in Jio Platforms Ltd.’s $3.1 billion India-record initial public offering, trading on the unofficial market is fueling hopes of a big debut pop. Billionaire Mukesh Ambani’s digital and telecommunications giant has attracted stellar demand across investor categories ahead of its Oct. 28 market debut. Investors who got their allocations on Tuesday are now closely watching Jio’s gray-market pricing for clues about how the first day might unfold. The premium over the IPO price has hovered at about 22% for roughly 10 days, unusually resilient for an offering of this size, according to the ipowatch.in and investorgain.com platforms.  Gray market premiums are unregulated and provide no guarantee of where a stock will actually trade once it hits the exchange. Still, they are widely tracked in India as a barometer of demand and listing-day sentiment. If the pattern holds into the listing, it would make Jio India’s second-most valuable company after parent Reliance Industries Ltd., pushing rival Bharti Airtel Ltd. into third place. That prospect is adding to the excitement around an IPO that’s already rewritten records in India’s capital markets. Jio attracted more than $78 billion in bids and nearly 14 million applications in one of the country’s most anticipated listings.  So far, Jio has been able to defy the usual trend of gray market premiums cooling after an IPO closes, as the initial rush of bidding fades and investors shift their focus to allotments and the eventual listing. After National Stock Exchange of India Ltd.’s $2.4 billion IPO, the premium gradually eroded from about 15% to 3% in two weeks and the shares ultimately made a relatively muted debut.The optimism is backed by blockbuster subscription numbers. Jio’s IPO was subscribed more than 22 times, with qualified institutional buyers bidding for 71 times the shares reserved for them. Wealthy investors subscribed 14 times their allocation, while the retail portion was covered 2.7 times. The offering was fully subscribed within just 100 minutes of opening last week, even as a bruising selloff swept through Indian equities.

item.title: Cómico británico Brand aseguró en el juicio que nunca mantuvo relaciones sexuales sin consentimiento
item.description: El cómico y actor británico Russell Brand declaró ante la policía que nunca había mantenido relaciones sexuales no consentidas, a pesar de haber tenido encuentros en innumerables lugares y situaciones, según se informó el martes en un tribunal de Londres.
item.dc:creator: Michael Holden
item.content:encoded: El cómico y actor británico Russell Brand declaró ante la policía que nunca había mantenido relaciones sexuales no consentidas, a pesar de haber tenido encuentros en innumerables lugares y situaciones, según se informó el martes en un tribunal de Londres. Brand, que en su día fue uno de los presentadores más destacados de Gran Bretaña y exmarido de la cantante estadounidense Katy Perry, está siendo juzgado en el Tribunal Penal de Southwark, en Londres, por acusaciones de delitos sexuales contra seis mujeres entre 1999 y 2009. El hombre, de 51 años, ha negado todas las acusaciones. BRAND ABSUELTO DE UN CARGO, SE LE IMPUTA OTRO Se le imputan tres cargos de violación y tres de agresión sexual y, el martes, el juez ordenó al jurado que dictara un veredicto de "no culpable" respecto a una acusación de abuso sexual. Sin embargo, ahora se enfrentará a un nuevo cargo de intento de abuso sexual por ese supuesto incidente. Anteriormente se había explicado al jurado cómo todas las mujeres se presentaron ante los detectives tras la emisión de un documental en 2023, junto con una serie de artículos periodísticos sobre él. La fiscalía ha expuesto sus argumentos según los cuales Brand era un depredador despiadado y se espera que el excomediante exponga su defensa el miércoles. Pero el martes se dieron a conocer por primera vez ante el tribunal sus respuestas a las acusaciones. Los fiscales leyeron las declaraciones preparadas que Brand proporcionó a la policía durante cuatro entrevistas celebradas entre septiembre de 2023 y julio de 2025 a raíz de las acusaciones. En estas declaraciones, afirmó que el documental y los reportajes periodísticos "difamatorios y ficticios", que contenían "acusaciones falsas y anónimas" contra él, habían llevado a los medios de comunicación y a la policía a recabar otras acusaciones en su contra. Esto, según él, había allanado el camino para que "se inventaran o se reimaginaran nuevos incidentes". "Nunca he participado en ninguna actividad sexual no consentida", decía su declaración. Afirmó que había declarado en repetidas ocasiones que en el pasado había tenido una vida sexual muy promiscua, un comportamiento que ahora condenaba. Dijo que había mantenido relaciones sexuales en los baños de las fiestas y que había tenido encuentros sexuales en "innumerables lugares y situaciones, a menudo con personas que acababa de conocer". "Esos encuentros siempre fueron consentidos", afirmó. El jurado ha escuchado acusaciones de que Brand violó a una mujer tras conocerla en un acto paralelo a la conferencia del Partido Laborista en 1999, obligó a una mujer a practicarle sexo oral en los baños de un bar londinense en 2004 y había acosado sexualmente a otra mujer en una emisora de radio en 2004 ó 2005. También se le acusa de intentar arrastrar a una mujer al baño de hombres de MTV Europe, en Londres, donde ella trabajaba en 2001, y de violar analmente a una mujer que había accedido a mantener relaciones sexuales consentidas en su domicilio en 2009. La última acusación es que agredió a una mujer que trabajaba en la cadena de televisión Channel 4, donde ambos participaban en un proyecto de grabación.

item.title: Publicaciones engañosas omiten saludo entre Zelenski y el rey de Suecia
item.description: Un clip de un encuentro en abril entre el rey de Suecia, Carlos XVI Gustavo, y el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, fue compartido de forma engañosa en redes sociales para decir que el monarca se negó a estrechar la mano del mandatario.
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: Un clip de un encuentro en abril entre el rey de Suecia, Carlos XVI Gustavo, y el presidente de Ucrania, Volodímir Zelenski, fue compartido de forma engañosa en redes sociales para decir que el monarca se negó a estrechar la mano del mandatario. Estos son los detalles clave: El clip fue grabado durante la visita del rey de Suecia a Leópolis, Ucrania, el 17 de abril de 2026. Muestra al rey descender de su vehículo y posar con Zelenski para fotografías. La cadena pública ucraniana Suspilne Novyny compartió una versión más larga del video, que muestra al segundo 00:25 cómo ambos se estrechan la mano. Una fotografía de la Oficina de la Presidencia de Ucrania y un video de Reuters también capturaron el saludo. En un correo del 27 de octubre, la Corte Real de Suecia dijo que el rey y Zelenski se dieron la mano en varias ocasiones. Remitió a una publicación del 26 de octubre del primer ministro sueco, Ulf Kristersson, en la que se refirió al video y expresó su apoyo a Ucrania. La ministra de Asuntos Exteriores de Suecia, Maria Malmer Stenergard, quien acompañó al rey durante la visita, también dijo en una publicación del 17 de abril que el rey y Zelenski se estrecharon la mano. La página de la Corte Real de Suecia no registra visitas del rey a Ucrania en octubre. Veredicto: Engañoso. El rey de Suecia y Zelenski se estrecharon la mano durante su encuentro en Leópolis en abril. Reuters Fact Check ofrece información confiable mediante su canal de WhatsApp para México . Envíenos un mensaje con el contenido en español que desea que verifiquemos. Este artículo fue realizado por el equipo de Reuters Fact Check. Lea más sobre nuestro trabajo de verificación de afirmaciones en las redes sociales.

item.title: Trump diz que visitará no Texas petroleiro com primeiro petróleo de acordo com Venezuela
item.description: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta terça-feira que planeja visitar um navio-tanque no Texas que contém o primeiro petróleo recebido da Venezuela, após um acordo firmado por Washington depois da destituição do ex-líder do país.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, afirmou nesta terça-feira que planeja visitar um navio-tanque no Texas que contém o primeiro petróleo recebido da Venezuela, após um acordo firmado por Washington depois da destituição do ex-líder do país. Trump anunciou em agosto um acordo que concede aos Estados Unidos acesso a um quinto das reservas de petróleo bruto da Venezuela. “Eles me enviaram, como presente, um carregamento de um milhão de barris de petróleo, e vou entregar isso aos Estados Unidos da América”, disse Trump aos repórteres. Mais tarde, ele afirmou em uma postagem no Truth Social que essa era a “primeira remessa de BILHÕES de barris que estão por vir”. A Casa Branca informou em setembro que o petróleo proveniente do acordo com a Venezuela provavelmente chegaria às reservas dos EUA em novembro. Os Estados Unidos vêm trabalhando em estreita colaboração com o governo interino liderado pela presidente interina, Delcy Rodríguez, desde que forças americanas capturaram o então presidente Nicolás Maduro em janeiro.

item.title: Oracle amplía su acuerdo de suministro de chips con Nvidia e incorpora la oferta de Google y Cerebras
item.description: Oracle anunció el martes que está ampliando sus acuerdos sobre chips de IA en la nube con Nvidia, al tiempo que diversifica su oferta para incluir productos de competidores de Nvidia, como Google, de Alphabet , y Cerebras Systems.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Nellis
item.content:encoded: Oracle anunció el martes que está ampliando sus acuerdos sobre chips de IA en la nube con Nvidia, al tiempo que diversifica su oferta para incluir productos de competidores de Nvidia, como Google, de Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , y Cerebras Systems. Oracle (ORCL.N) y Nvidia (NVDA.O) dijeron que la empresa de servicios en la nube se expandirá a una "escala de varios gigavatios" con la última generación de servidores de IA "Vera Rubin" de Nvidia. Las empresas no revelaron el valor del acuerdo, aunque el director ejecutivo de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, había declarado anteriormente que los sistemas Vera Rubin pueden generar hasta 40.000 millones de dólares en ingresos por gigavatio para el fabricante de chips. Oracle también está diversificando su oferta y ha señalado que incluso los sistemas basados en Nvidia prescindirán de algunos de los chips de red de Nvidia en favor de los chips de red "Acceleron", desarrollados internamente por Oracle. El martes, Oracle anunció que comenzará a ofrecer por primera vez los chips de unidad de procesamiento tensorial (TPU) de Google. "Las diferentes cargas de trabajo de IA tienen distintas necesidades de computación", afirmó Mahesh Thiagarajan, presidente de Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, en un comunicado. "Esa opción ofrece a los clientes la flexibilidad de elegir la infraestructura adecuada en función del rendimiento, la productividad y la rentabilidad de cada carga de trabajo de IA". Además de los chips de Google, Oracle tiene previsto ofrecer chips de SambaNova Systems y Cerebras Systems (CBRS.O) , dos empresas respaldadas por Intel (INTC.O) , que fabrican chips para lo que se conoce como "inferencia", es decir, cuando los sistemas de IA responden a las solicitudes de los usuarios humanos. Mientras que Nvidia domina el mercado del entrenamiento de sistemas de IA, el mercado de la inferencia es más competitivo y diverso. "Se trata de una expansión masiva de nuestra base de clientes de primer nivel", dijo el director ejecutivo de Cerebras, Andrew Feldman, sobre el acuerdo con Oracle en una entrevista con Reuters. "Nos están implementando a gran escala en los centros de datos de terceros". Oracle, que tiene previsto celebrar esta semana una jornada para inversores, no ha revelado cómo piensa financiar la compra de los chips. Durante una conferencia sobre resultados celebrada el mes pasado, Oracle señaló que los clientes asumen cada vez más el costo de los chips y mantuvo su objetivo de gasto de capital de entre 90.000 y 95.000 millones de dólares para el ejercicio fiscal de 2027.

item.title: Bolsas europeas no sufren por flojo desempeño de HSBC, otros resultados mejoran ánimo inversores
item.description: Los buenos resultados empresariales y la baja del petróleo contribuyeron a que las acciones europeas cerraran al alza el martes, compensando las pérdidas registradas a primera hora de la sesión, cuando HSBC lastró el ánimo de los inversores tras no alcanzar los ingresos trimestrales previstos.
item.dc:creator: Avinash P, Niket Nishant
item.content:encoded: Los buenos resultados empresariales y la baja del petróleo contribuyeron a que las acciones europeas cerraran al alza el martes, compensando las pérdidas registradas a primera hora de la sesión, cuando HSBC lastró el ánimo de los inversores tras no alcanzar los ingresos trimestrales previstos. El índice paneuropeo STOXX 600 (.STOXX) subió un 0,47% a 643,68 puntos, tras haber llegado a caer un 0,41% a primera hora. Estas subidas sitúan al índice en una posición potencialmente más sólida de cara a la decisión sobre las tasas de interés del Banco Central Europeo el jueves, en la que se espera que los responsables de la política monetaria mantengan estables los costos de financiación. "Esperamos que la presidenta del BCE, Christine Lagarde, transmita un mensaje equilibrado entre los riesgos al alza que siguen existiendo por los precios de la energía, los datos benignos de la inflación subyacente y unas condiciones financieras más restrictivas", escribieron analistas de Goldman Sachs. Los resultados de HSBC (HSBA.L) , el mayor banco de Europa, rompieron la reciente tendencia de buenos resultados en el sector bancario, lo que decepcionó a los inversores. Las acciones del banco con sede en Londres cayeron más de un 5%, tocando su mínimo en más de cuatro meses después de que sus ingresos no alcanzaran las previsiones, en parte debido a un crecimiento más lento en su negocio de gestión patrimonial. Estas caídas arrastraron al índice británico FTSE 100 (.FTSE) a un descenso del 0,75%. La bolsa francesa (.FCHI) subió un 0,51% tras caer más de un 2% la semana pasada, cuando las protestas sacudieron la segunda economía más grande de la zona del euro. La confianza de los consumidores franceses cayó en octubre hasta su nivel más bajo desde junio de 2013, según datos publicados el martes. Entre otras empresas destacadas, Novartis (NOVN.S) elevó sus previsiones de beneficio operativo básico para todo el año, lo que impulsó las acciones de la farmacéutica suiza un 1% al alza.

item.title: Four investors in talks to buy key parts of ammunition firm Forges de Tarbes, says minister
item.description: The French government is in talks with four, un-named investors to take over the key, technical know-how assets of Les Forges de Tarbes, French defence minister Catherine Vautrin said on Tuesday during a parliamentary committee.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The French government is in talks with four, un-named investors to take over the key, technical know-how assets of Les Forges de Tarbes, French defence minister Catherine Vautrin said on Tuesday during a parliamentary committee. Shell maker Forge de Tarbes, which supplies Franco-German tank maker KNDS for its Caesar howitzer, was placed under receivership this week. France has supplied Caesar howitzers to Ukraine after the Russian invasion of 2022.

item.title: Google presenta Genie 4, una versión mejorada de su IA para crear mundos virtuales
item.description: La nueva versión permite crear entornos explorables a partir de texto, modificar escenas en tiempo real y generar audio e imágenes simultáneamente. Google planea ampliar el acceso a evaluadores y susc ...
item.dc:creator: Davey Alba
item.content:encoded: Bloomberg — Google, de Alphabet Inc. ( GOOGL ), anunció una nueva versión de su modelo de mundo de inteligencia artificial que genera entornos virtuales más realistas y en tiempo real, impulsando una tecnología que ha inquietado a los inversores en empresas de videojuegos. Genie 4, presentado el martes por el laboratorio de IA Google DeepMind de la compañía, permite a los usuarios crear mundos explorables a partir de indicaciones de texto y navegar por ellos mediante controles de teclado. También pueden modificar una escena a medida que se desarrolla escribiendo instrucciones, como cambiar el clima o añadir un personaje. Google afirmó que las simulaciones pueden durar hasta dos minutos, lo que prácticamente duplica la capacidad de su predecesor, Genie 3. Genie 4 es también el primero de sus productos en generar sonido e imágenes simultáneamente, incluyendo ruido ambiental, música y diálogos que reaccionan a los usuarios. Ver más: Anthropic aumenta su dependencia de Google, Amazon y Microsoft Google está lanzando Genie 4 como una versión preliminar para un pequeño grupo de evaluadores de confianza. En las próximas semanas, la compañía planea ofrecerla a los suscriptores del plan Google AI Ultra, el de mayor nivel, así como a algunos desarrolladores que utilizan las herramientas de creación de aplicaciones, Google AI Studio y la API Gemini. Los modelos de mundo son un tipo de IA que genera entornos interactivos sobre la marcha, en lugar de solo vídeo. Cuando Google presentó Project Genie, un prototipo basado en el modelo Genie 3, en enero, causó revuelo en Wall Street. Las acciones de las empresas de videojuegos cayeron bruscamente mientras los inversores sopesaban si las herramientas de IA podrían revolucionar la forma en que se crean los videojuegos. Si bien Google enfrenta una intensa competencia de rivales como OpenAI y Anthropic PBC en el campo de la IA, su modelo Gemini 4 Argon, anunciado recientemente, se considera clave para reducir la brecha. Los modelos del mundo real y la multimodalidad —la capacidad de la IA para trabajar con imágenes, audio y video, además de texto— se han considerado durante mucho tiempo los puntos fuertes tecnológicos de Google. Ver más: Google abre su Play Store a aplicaciones creadas con IA para uso personal El nuevo modelo se apoya en Gemini para mantener la coherencia de sus mundos. Cuando Genie 4 renderiza una escena, Gemini analiza los fotogramas entrantes, interpreta el objetivo del usuario y lo desglosa en una serie de pasos, para luego verificar que cada uno se haya completado, según explicó Google en una publicación de blog. La compañía indicó que su equipo experimentó con Argon, pero la experiencia en tiempo real se ejecuta en Gemini 3.8 Flash, su modelo más ligero y potente. Google afirmó que evaluadores de confianza, entre ellos desarrolladores de videojuegos y cineastas, están probando Genie 4 para tareas como convertir un concepto en un prototipo interactivo y esbozar escenas. La compañía también está estudiando si podría ayudar a entrenar robots, aunque aún no está claro si alguno de estos usos se popularizará. En una rueda de prensa, Diego Rivas, gerente de producto de Google DeepMind, preguntó sobre el impacto en la industria de los videojuegos. Rivas explicó que la compañía está colaborando con sus socios para comprender cómo se integra la tecnología en su trabajo y cuáles son sus límites. “La idea es ampliar las posibilidades actuales”, afirmó Rivas. Ver más: Google lanza agente Gemini “universal” que funciona en Gmail, Drive, Docs y Calendar: ¿cómo funciona? Google recalcó que el modelo aún es experimental. Los detalles visuales y los objetos pueden variar a medida que la simulación se prolonga, y Hang Qi, ingeniero de investigación de Google DeepMind, afirmó que alcanzar el límite de dos minutos del modelo no significa necesariamente que una escena se mantenga completamente consistente en todo momento. Las interacciones físicas complejas, el texto legible y la coherencia a largo plazo aún están en desarrollo. Lograr que los mundos virtuales sean completamente coherentes, aunque sea durante dos minutos, requeriría que el modelo comprendiera a fondo la física del mundo cotidiano, según Tejas Kulkarni, director de investigación de Google DeepMind. “No se puede hacer mucho en dos minutos”, dijo Rivas. “Todavía estamos en la fase de investigación. No estamos necesariamente en la fase del producto final”. La compañía afirmó que todo el audio y el vídeo generados por Genie 4 llevarán SynthID, la marca de agua invisible de Google para identificar el contenido generado por IA. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

item.title: NYSE moves to bring all-or-nothing options to stocks and company earnings
item.description: The New York Stock Exchange is preparing to start trading a new type of options contract that lets investors make all-or-nothing bets on whether a stock or exchange-traded fund will close above or below a set price.
item.dc:creator: Laura Matthews
item.content:encoded: The New York Stock Exchange is preparing to start trading a new type of options contract that lets investors make all-or-nothing bets on whether a stock or exchange-traded fund will close above or below a set price. The launch comes as trading in options and event-based contracts has surged, prompting exchanges to develop new products that appeal to both retail and institutional investors looking for more precise ways to express market views and manage risk. NYSE is also seeking approval for a second product tied to company earnings metrics, the latest push by exchanges to capitalize on booming demand for event-driven trading. The binary return options contracts are expected to begin trading within days. The lineup includes 12 underlying securities, including Apple (AAPL.O) , Nvidia (NVDA.O) , Tesla (TSLA.O) and the SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust , with additional securities to be added over time. "We've seen this incredible growth in the US options market over the last several years. When we look inside that volume growth, there's a lot of interest in newer ways to trade or newer products to trade," said Kevin Tyrrell, chief product officer at NYSE. Options contracts give holders the right, but not the obligation, to buy or sell the underlying asset at a predetermined price. NYSE is also awaiting US Securities and Exchange Commission approval for binary key performance indicator, or KPI, options, which would pay investors based on whether a company reports a specified result above or below a certain threshold. Unlike traditional stock options, whose value is tied to share price moves, KPI options would allow investors to trade directly on metrics such as net sales, earnings per share, cloud-computing revenue or vehicle production. The cash-settled, European-style contracts, meaning they can be exercised only at expiration, would pay either $1 or nothing at expiration, depending on whether the reported metric meets the contract's strike level. Cboe Global Markets recently received approval for similar KPI-based contracts in partnership with Robinhood (HOOD.O) .

item.title: EssilorLuxottica has clear succession planning for top roles, director says
item.description: EssilorLuxottica has clear and strong succession plans for the role of chief executive and other senior executives, the head of the board's nominations committee at the French-Italian eyewear giant said on Tuesday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: EssilorLuxottica (ESLX.PA) has clear and strong succession plans for the role of chief executive and other senior executives, the head of the board's nominations committee at the French-Italian eyewear giant said on Tuesday. His comments follow a radio interview by one of the heirs of late Luxottica founder Leonardo Del Vecchio, who complained about EssilorLuxottica CEO Francesco Milleri's alleged failure to prepare for his eventual succession at the helm. "Any reports casting doubt on the strength of the succession planning at the top are entirely unfounded and damaging to the company's image and to the professionalism of its managers," Andrea Zappia, who chairs EssilorLuxottica's nominations and compensation committee, said in a statement. "There is a clear, well-defined and constantly updated succession plan for the roles of CEO and Deputy CEO and for all top positions, which, in line with the founder's vision, favors internal growth paths and has already proven its strength," Zappia added. He added the management team supporting Milleri - who was Del Vecchio's closest aide and chairs Delfin, the holding company that holds the family's EssilorLuxottica stake and other investments - had recently been reinforced and included "high-quality managers who can continue to grow". On Tuesday, Leonardo Maria Del Vecchio said his late father had tasked Milleri with leading the succession at the helm of the family's business empire, adding the EssilorLuxottica CEO had failed to fulfill such a mandate. Milleri comes up for renewal as CEO of EssilorLuxottica at the next general meeting, which is expected to be held in the spring.

CAPE TOWN, Oct 27 : Fast bowler Mitchell Starc did not know Australia’s premier batsman Steve Smith would not take part in the decisive third test against South Africa at Newlands on Tuesday until he went to warm-up ahead of play. Smith tested his neck injury in the nets on Tuesday morning but was still experiencing discomfort, captain Pat Cummins said at the toss. "He wasn't happy with how his neck was feeling, so we had to look elsewhere," Cummins said. Smith's absence meant he would not feature at the ground where he was embroiled in the 2018 ball-tampering 'Sandpapergate' scandal, with much of the pre-match focus centred on how Australia's most experienced batsman would cope with the occasion.

"I did not know he was not playing until I went out to warm-up today," Starc told reporters after the day’s play. “He has been battling that neck since last week. “I don’t actually know what happened with that and I have not asked. He seems upbeat enough, but I don’t know what he has had done.” After winning the toss, Cummins opted to bowl, a rare decision at Newlands that might have been taken with the reshuffle of the top six batsmen after Josh Inglis learnt just before the start he would replace Smith.   The move initially appeared to have backfired as South Africa made a strong start. However, Starc produced a masterful spell with the second new ball late in the day, finishing with figures of 6-72 as the hosts were dismissed for 329 on the stroke of stumps. “I am not in that pay bracket,” Starc said when asked if he agreed with the decision to bowl first. “My opinion doesn’t matter. It is what it is. At one point it looked like we were bowling a fair bit tomorrow, so it was good to bowl them out today. “There was clearly not as much swing and sideways movement as we thought might be on offer (early in the day). But we found different ways to be effective and if you delete that first session, I think the last two were back on what we expected.” It was another see-saw day in a series that has already seen plenty of twists and turns. “These are two very good cricket teams. At times it is going to get away from you, at times you will wrestle the momentum back, which we did in the second half the day,” Starc said. “I expect more swings through the test match as we now need to go and bat and they have a very good (bowling) attack.”

Source: Reuters

item.title: Constellation gets conditional $5 billion US DOE loan commitment for nuclear plant upgrades
item.description: Constellation Energy said on Tuesday it received a conditional loan commitment of up to $5 billion from the US Department of Energy to fund nuclear uprates that will help it generate 1.1 gigawatts more power.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Constellation Energy (CEG.O) said on Tuesday it received a conditional loan commitment of up to $5 billion from the US Department of Energy to fund nuclear uprates that will help it generate 1.1 gigawatts more power. Demand for power in the US is growing after decades due to AI data center expansion, electrification of transportation and cryptocurrency mining. President Donald Trump set a goal to quadruple US nuclear power capacity by 2050. The US Department of Energy has hundreds of billions of dollars in financing available from its loan programs, the bulk of which is expected to support nuclear plants, according to energy secretary Chris Wright. Nuclear uprates increase power generation from existing reactors. The potential financing will help Constellation fund uprates at eight facilities in Illinois, Maryland and Pennsylvania, adding enough electricity to power more than 930,000 homes. This can lower costs and strengthen grid reliability in those states and across the PJM Interconnection and the Midcontinent Independent System Operator regions, the company said. Constellation, whose shares ticked up 1.8%, said the DOE-backed financing could reduce borrowing costs and speed up projects without having to build new plants or lay down transmission lines. Maryland-based Constellation is the largest US nuclear power plant operator. It owns a major fleet of natural-gas-fired as well as geothermal energy plants following its acquisition of electricity producer Calpine Corp earlier this year.

item.title: Judge hears Justice Dept's suit claiming noncitizens on California voter rolls
item.description: A US judge heard arguments on Tuesday on the Justice Department's request to block California from counting any mail ballots for the November 3 midterm elections from more than 20,000 registered voters the Trump administration alleges are likely noncitizens.
item.dc:creator: Luc Cohen, Jan Wolfe
item.content:encoded: A US judge heard arguments on Tuesday on the Justice Department's request to block California from counting any mail ballots for the November 3 midterm elections from more than 20,000 registered voters the Trump administration alleges are likely noncitizens. The Justice Department's October 15 lawsuit marked an escalation in President Donald Trump 's effort to boost the federal government's role in elections ahead of the midterms, with his Republican Party locked in a tight battle to retain control of both houses of Congress. The lawsuit is a rare intervention by the Justice Department in the voting process weeks before an election. The US Constitution assigns the responsibility of administering elections to individual states, though the federal government has some oversight role. US District Judge David Carter is holding a court hearing in Los Angeles to consider the department's request for a temporary restraining order barring officials from [USN:L6N46117W TEXT:"counting any ballots"] from the individuals it flagged. California has said the state's safeguards against noncitizen voting are robust. It said the Justice Department's assertions relied on "suspect data" and that complying with its demands would risk disenfranchising eligible voters. California is the most populous US state and a Democratic stronghold. It has more seats in the House of Representatives — 52 — than any other state. Trump has made California a focal point of his sweeping immigration crackdown since returning to the White House, accusing it of undermining public safety through its "sanctuary state" policies that limit cooperation with federal immigration enforcement. Trump has repeatedly insisted that states are not doing enough to stop voting by noncitizens, which he says is widespread despite multiple studies and state audits showing it is rare. CALIFORNIA SAYS SAFEGUARDS ARE ROBUST The hearing comes after a federal appeals court on Monday [USN:L2N46C163 TEXT:"rejected"] an unusual emergency request by the Justice Department asking the appeals court to temporarily block California from counting the ballots before Carter had the chance to rule. The Justice Department did not indicate how many of the more than 20,000 people it flagged in California had actually submitted a mail ballot. Apart from California, the Trump administration has sought to intervene in elections in two states that are home to [USN:L6N4670ZS TEXT:"competitive races"]. In Alaska, the Justice Department last week asked a judge to [USN:L2N46D019 TEXT:"prevent certification"] of election results if the Republican incumbent senator loses by a slim margin, alleging that the presence of another candidate with a similar name on the ballot could confuse voters. Alaska has urged that the case be dismissed, arguing it has taken steps to distinguish the two candidates on the ballot. In Washington state, the Justice Department on Monday [USN:L6N46D0UP TEXT:"sent a letter"] asking officials not to count any ballots received from 400 voters it said may not be citizens. Washington's top elections official said the timing of the request indicated it was intended to cast unfounded suspicion on election results. California had 23 million registered voters as of December 2025, while Washington had 5 million registered voters as of 2024, state records show. Voting rights activists have expressed concern that the federal government's methods for scrutinizing state voter lists to identify noncitizen voters risk wrongly flagging naturalized citizens for removal from the rolls.

item.title: Trump says he will visit tanker in Texas with first oil from Venezuela deal
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he planned to visit a tanker in Texas which contains the first oil received from Venezuela following a deal that Washington made after deposing the country's former leader.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Tuesday said he planned to visit a tanker in Texas which contains the first oil received from Venezuela following a deal that Washington made after deposing the country's former leader. [USN:FWN44P1ZC TEXT:"Trump announced in August an agreement"] that grants the United States access to a fifth of Venezuela's crude reserves. "They've sent me as a gift a boatload of a million barrels of oil, and I'm giving that to the United States of America," Trump told reporters. He later said in a post on Truth Social that this was the "first shipment of BILLIONS of Barrels to come." The White House said in September that oil from the Venezuela deal would probably hit US reserves in November. The United States has been working closely with the interim government led by acting President Delcy Rodriguez since US forces captured President Nicolas Maduro in January.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro viaja para os EUA após derrota na eleição, dizem fontes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro viajou para os Estados Unidos, disseram à Reuters um aliado próximo do parlamentar e uma fonte do governo dos EUA nesta terça-feira, menos de 24 horas após o senador assegurar que nunca pensou em deixar o país e depois da derrota eleitoral no domingo para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva.
item.dc:creator: Ricardo Brito, Gram Slattery
item.content:encoded: Flávio Bolsonaro viajou para os Estados Unidos, disseram à Reuters um aliado próximo do parlamentar e uma fonte do governo dos EUA nesta terça-feira, menos de 24 horas após o senador assegurar que nunca pensou em deixar o país e depois da derrota eleitoral no domingo para o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva. A Embaixada dos EUA no Brasil não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário. Não ficou imediatamente claro para qual local exatamente Flávio Bolsonaro estava indo, a que horas chegaria ou se pediria asilo nos EUA. O governo do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, já alegou que o pai de Flávio, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, foi vítima de perseguição judicial no Brasil. Flávio descumpriu uma decisão do ministro Alexandre de Moraes, do Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF), para que entregasse seus passaportes nesta terça-feira pela manhã, o que levou a Polícia Federal a cancelar os passaportes do senador, inclusive o diplomático. A Reuters não conseguiu confirmar com quem o senador viajou aos EUA, mas apurou com uma fonte que as duas filhas do parlamentar não foram para a escola em Brasília nesta terça. "Eu nunca pensei em sair do país. Eu vou entregar os meus passaportes e vou me defender dessa aberração, que é uma clara tentativa de me intimidar", disse Flávio em vídeo publicado em sua conta no Instagram na segunda-feira, afirmando ainda que organizaria a oposição ao governo Lula. Moraes determinou a entrega dos passaportes de Flávio no âmbito de um inquérito em que o senador é investigado por lavagem de dinheiro juntamente com o advogado Willer Tomaz, amigo do senador. Ambos os acusados negam qualquer irregularidade. A decisão do ministro do STF foi tomada após o ex-deputado Eduardo Bolsonaro, irmão de Flávio, dizer em uma transmissão nas redes sociais que Flávio deveria deixar o país caso perdesse a eleição presidencial. A viagem de Flávio para os Estados Unidos repetiria os passos do pai, o ex-presidente Jair Bolsonaro, que viajou para os Estados Unidos depois de se recusar a reconhecer a derrota para Lula na eleição presidencial de 2022. Jair Bolsonaro acabou retornando ao Brasil, mas posteriormente foi condenado a 27 anos de prisão por tentativa de golpe de Estado. Flávio ainda não reconheceu oficialmente a derrota no domingo. No dia da votação, afirmou que buscaria a anulação do resultado alegando irregularidades após a prorrogação do prazo de votação. Posteriormente, disse que pediria a cassação da chapa de Lula ao Tribunal Superior Eleitoral (TSE). No entanto, seu partido, o PL, declarou na segunda-feira que reconhecia a vitória de Lula.

item.title: US agency is again probing if Polymarket broke 2022 settlement, sources says
item.description: A US regulator is investigating whether prediction market operator Polymarket violated a 2022 enforcement deal in which it promised to ban US users from its main overseas platform, reviving an inquiry the agency shuttered last year without bringing charges, said two people familiar with the matter.
item.dc:creator: Chris Prentice
item.content:encoded: A US regulator is investigating whether prediction market operator Polymarket violated a 2022 enforcement deal in which it promised to ban US users from its main overseas platform, [USN:L1N3ML0V9 TEXT:"reviving an inquiry"] the agency shuttered last year without bringing charges, said two people familiar with the matter. The Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing whether Polymarket took sufficient steps to keep US users off the platform as part of a broader investigation it opened into the company earlier this year, the people said. One of the people said the scrutiny is focused on Polymarket's past controls and processes. The agency is examining Polymarket's controls for determining where customers are located, as well as its advertising activities in the United States, as part of that inquiry, the people said. Polymarket is based in New York and has an offshore entity registered in Panama. The CFTC is also scrutinizing Polymarket's US platform, which the company began rolling out late last year, including its customer onboarding processes and customer protections, said the people, who spoke on the condition of anonymity to discuss confidential enforcement issues. Reuters is reporting these elements of the probe for the first time. The Wall Street Journal, Bloomberg News and other media first reported in June that the CFTC was broadly probing Polymarket, but provided few details. Bloomberg added that the CFTC was looking into social media activity tied to the company. Spokespeople for the CFTC and Polymarket declined to comment. Probes are not necessarily an indication of wrongdoing and many do not result in enforcement action. The new details, nevertheless, raise fresh questions over why the CFTC and Justice Department last year closed similar probes into whether Polymarket had violated the 2022 settlement, which resolved CFTC allegations at the time that Polymarket had been operating in the US unlawfully since its launch in 2020. Neither agency has commented on the decision to close the probes and a Justice Department spokesperson declined to comment for this story. Prediction markets allow traders to bet on real-world events, including sports, government policy announcements and [USN:L4N45Y17K TEXT:"elections"]. Aided by supportive policies under President Donald Trump's second administration, the industry has surged over the past two years. Trump's son, Donald Trump Jr, is a Polymarket investor. As the platforms have grown, they have drawn scrutiny from Democratic lawmakers and advocacy groups worried the platforms are creating new avenues for [USN:L6N41C1D6 TEXT:"insider trading"], while recent political upsets, [USN:L6N46C031 TEXT:"including in Brazil"] this week, have raised questions about their accuracy. Polymarket has said it has revamped controls. The firm says it expressly prohibits the use of virtual private networks (VPNs) or similar tools to circumvent its geographic restrictions, and has extensive controls to monitor for misconduct and to prevent restricted users from accessing its offshore platform. [USN:L6N44P0U4 TEXT:"Speaking to Reuters in August"], Shana Bautista, Polymarket's global head of investigations and intelligence, said US users circumventing its restrictions was not "a really prevalent issue." BIDEN ADMINISTRATION AGENCIES OPENED PROBE IN 2024 Under the 2022 settlement negotiated by the CFTC's former Biden-era leadership, Polymarket agreed to stop offering its market to US users. But as 2024 US election bets on the platform grew, political pundits and social media users [USN:L1N3LU0ST TEXT:"questioned whether Americans"] were circumventing Polymarket's restrictions. Months before the election, the CFTC opened a probe into whether Polymarket was complying with the deal, [USN:L1N3ML0V9 TEXT:"Reuters"] and other media reported at the time. The Justice Department opened a related investigation, with the [USN:L1N3MK1FR TEXT:"FBI searching"] Polymarket CEO Shayne Coplan's New York home in November 2024. Two months later, the Trump administration took office and appointed new leaders to both agencies. On July 15, 2025, Coplan said in an X post that the CFTC and Justice Department had closed their probes and cleared the company of any wrongdoing. A week later, Polymarket said it had bought a CFTC-licensed derivatives exchange, which became the platform for its US operation. CFTC-registered platforms must comply with certain customer protection and market abuse prevention requirements. While CFTC data shows the agency's overall enforcement activity has slumped during Trump's second presidency, its enforcement director David Miller [USN:SPN40F00M TEXT:"said during his first month on the job in March"] that he would aggressively police prediction markets. In April, [USN:FWN41616V TEXT:"the agency and Justice Department charged"] a US soldier, alleging he made $400,000 from insider bets on Polymarket's offshore platform, sparking fresh questions about its controls. According to the indictment, Gannon Ken Van Dyke, who has pleaded not guilty, accessed the platform using a VPN and "exit mode," which geolocated to a foreign country. Polymarket said at the time that it had referred the matter to the authorities.

item.title: GM to offer hybrid SUVs in strategic pivot from electric
item.description: General Motors plans to introduce hybrid versions of its popular three-row SUVs, people familiar with the matter said, in a strategic shift after heavily investing in electric vehicles.
item.dc:creator: Kalea Hall, David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: General Motors (GM.N) plans to introduce hybrid versions of its popular three-row SUVs, people familiar with the matter said, in a strategic shift after heavily investing in electric vehicles. The US automaker plans to build hybrid models of the Chevrolet Traverse, Buick Enclave and GMC Acadia at a factory in Lansing, Michigan, the people told Reuters. The mechanically similar models are among GM's strongest sellers in the US. GM said in a statement after Reuters reported the plans on Tuesday that it plans to invest in its Lansing Delta Township assembly plant to prepare for hybrid-vehicle production. It did not provide details on timing or models. GM CEO SAYS HYBRIDS ARE COMING CEO Mary Barra told analysts during GM's earnings call last week that the carmaker would have hybrids in multiple segments. "It's not going to be additional (capital expenditures) and engineering," she said, adding that GM would say more about them as it got closer to launch. US [USN:L6N41K18Q TEXT:"hybrid sales have taken off"] as car shoppers seek relief from higher gas prices. GM, which only sells a hybrid version of the Chevy Corvette in the US, has lost market share this year, while strong hybrid players like Toyota have gained. Dealers have complained about [USN:L6N4570VU TEXT:"GM's lack of hybrids"], which combine a gas engine with a lithium-ion battery and electric motor to conserve fuel and boost power. GM DEALERS SAY THEY WANT HYBRIDS Dealers have been pressing the company to add hybrids to its lineup, some of those who have attended recent regional meetings between retailers and GM sales executives told Reuters. "We've been telling them every chance we get that we need hybrids," one dealer said. GM executives have in the past said hybrids add too much cost and complexity, and that they preferred to invest in EVs. Hybrids also didn't help GM meet stringent emissions standards that Trump's administration has upended. GM's US market share dropped to 16.6% in the first nine months of the year, from 17.4% a year before, while hybrid leaders Toyota and Honda gained. GM's hybrid plans have emerged days before the November 3 midterm congressional election, where several key Michigan seats are up for grabs. US President Donald Trump's administration has been eager to advertise its efforts to support US auto manufacturing. Energy Department Assistant Secretary Audrey Robertson is scheduled to tour the Lansing factory where GM plans to make the hybrids later on Tuesday. The department is restructuring a previously awarded grant to GM to support EV production at a nearby Lansing plant to now support hybrid production. In 2024, under President Joe Biden, the Energy Department awarded GM $500 million to retool another nearby Michigan assembly plant to build EVs but the money was not released. GM said those funds will go to its Lansing Delta Township for future hybrid production. The department did not respond to a request for comment.

Oct 27 : FIFA will carry out a series of visits to candidate host cities in Spain, Portugal and Morocco in November and December as part of the venue selection process for the 2030 World Cup, world football's governing body said on Tuesday. A FIFA delegation will visit candidate cities and stadiums in all three host countries to assess their suitability to host games. FIFA has yet to confirm which venues will be included, and has not announced where the World Cup final will be held, with Spain and Morocco battling to hold football's biggest match.  Visits are planned for Agadir, Casablanca, Fez, Marrakech, Rabat and Tangier in Morocco; Lisbon and Porto in Portugal; and Barcelona, Bilbao, Las Palmas, Madrid, San Sebastian, Seville and Zaragoza in Spain. FIFA said it may also conduct visits to additional venues during the selection process.
